title: BankId Connector Configuration
description: Configuration for BankId Connector. This schema defines the necessary properties for configuring the connection to BankId services, including environment selection and authentication details.

environment.description: Select which BankId environment to send requests to. Use 'SANDBOX' for testing with BankId's test environment. Use 'PRODUCTION' for live transactions requiring your own certificate, key and passphrase

certificate.description: Upload (or paste the contents of) the certificate file received from your bank to authenticate requests to BankID.

privateKey.description: Upload (or paste the contents of) the private key file received from your bank to authenticate requests to BankID.

passphrase.description: Enter or paste your passphrase for the private key
